subtitle_en: Grandma learns to use a smartphone
author: Text and translation by Claude (Anthropic)

segs.en: Grandma turned seventy this year.
On her birthday, her son gave her a new phone.
It was big and very pretty, but Grandma wasn't very happy.
“This phone is too hard. I can't use it. My old phone can only make calls, but it's easy to use.”

zh: 奶奶今年七十岁了。生日那天，她的儿子送给她一个新手机。手机很大，也很漂亮，可是奶奶不太高兴。她说：“这个手机太难了，我不会用。我的老手机只能打电话，可是很好用。”

segs.en: A New Phone
Grandma had been using her old phone for ten years.
The characters on it were big, and making calls was easy.
There was far too much on the new phone. Grandma looked at it for ages and still couldn't work out how to make a call.
She put the new phone down and took out her old one again.

zh: 奶奶的老手机已经用了十年了。上边的字很大，打电话很方便。新手机上的东西太多了，奶奶看了半天，也不知道怎么打电话。她放下新手机，又拿出了她的老手机。

segs.en: Ding Dong, her grandson, was fifteen and in middle school.
He loved going to Grandma's more than anything, and Grandma loved him best of all.
He saw Grandma's new phone lying on the table and asked, “Grandma, why aren't you using your new phone?”
“It's too hard,” said Grandma. “I'm old. I can't learn it.”

zh: 丁冬今年十五岁，上中学。他最喜欢去奶奶家，奶奶也最喜欢他。他看见奶奶的新手机在桌子上，就问：“奶奶，您怎么不用新手机？”奶奶说：“太难了。我老了，学不会。”

segs.en: Ding Dong said, “Grandma, a new phone can do lots of things. When you make a call, you can see me. You can also use it to look at maps, buy things and take pictures.”
He smiled. “Don't worry, I'll teach you. From now on I'll come every Saturday!”

zh: 丁冬说：“奶奶，新手机能做很多事。打电话的时候，您能看到我；您还能用手机看地图、买东西、照相。”他笑着说：“没关系，我来教您。以后星期六我都来！”

segs.en: Saturday Lessons
On the first Saturday, Ding Dong was there by nine in the morning.
Grandma listened and wrote in a notebook at the same time.
Ding Dong spoke very slowly, and Grandma wrote very carefully.
But the first lesson didn't go very well.
Grandma tried to call her son and got someone else's home. She tried to take a picture, and the photo showed her own big hand.
They both laughed.

zh: 第一个星期六，丁冬早上九点就来了。奶奶一边听，一边在本子上写。丁冬说得很慢，奶奶写得很认真。可是第一次课不太好。奶奶想给儿子打电话，可是打到了别人家；她想照相，可是照片上是她自己的大手。两个人都笑了。

segs.en: By the second Saturday, Grandma could make calls where she could see the other person.
She called her son, and his face appeared on the phone straight away.
Grandma was so happy she didn't know what to say. She just kept smiling.
Her son said, “Mum, you look lovely when you smile!”

zh: 第二个星期六，奶奶会打能看到人的电话了。她给儿子打电话，手机上马上出现了儿子的脸。奶奶高兴得不知道说什么，一直在笑。儿子说：“妈，您笑得真好看！”

segs.en: On the third Saturday, Grandma learned to buy things with the phone.
Before, when she went to buy vegetables, she had to walk a long way.
Now she just taps a few times at home, and the vegetables arrive at her door.
“This is so convenient!” said Grandma. “I should have learned this ages ago.”

zh: 第三个星期六，奶奶学用手机买东西。以前她去买菜，要走很远的路。现在她在家里点一点，菜就送到门口了。奶奶说：“这个太方便了！我早就应该学。”

segs.en: On the fourth Saturday, Ding Dong taught her to read the map on the phone.
The next day, Grandma took the bus by herself to visit an old friend.
She walked along looking at her phone, and found her friend's home on her own without asking anyone.

zh: 第四个星期六，丁冬教她看手机上的地图。第二天，奶奶一个人坐公共汽车去看一个老朋友。她一边走，一边看手机，没有问别人，自己就找到了朋友家。

segs.en: Grandma learned faster and faster.
At first she had lots of questions; now she asked fewer and fewer.
She often listened to music on her phone while she cooked, and sometimes she even sent Ding Dong photos of flowers.
Her son said, “Mum, you're better with your phone than I am now.”

zh: 奶奶学得越来越快。以前她有很多问题，现在她问得越来越少了。她常常一边做饭，一边用手机听音乐；有的时候，她还给丁冬发来花的照片。儿子说：“妈，您现在用手机用得比我还好。”

segs.en: Grandma's Students
A month later, Ding Dong had exams coming up.
He was very busy. For two weeks he didn't go to Grandma's, and he didn't call her either.
He thought, “Grandma can do everything now. She doesn't need me to teach her any more.”

zh: 一个月以后，丁冬要考试了。他很忙，有两个星期没去奶奶家，也没给奶奶打电话。他想：“奶奶现在什么都会了，不用我教了。”

segs.en: One evening, Ding Dong's phone rang. It was Grandma!
On the screen he could see Grandma, and five or six other old people too.
They were all sitting around Grandma, and they were all holding phones too.
It turned out that the old people in her building had heard Grandma could use a new phone, and they had all come to learn from her.
Grandma explained and showed them as she went.
She spoke slowly and clearly, just like a real teacher.

zh: 一天晚上，丁冬的手机响了。是奶奶！手机上有奶奶，还有五六个老人。他们都坐在奶奶旁边，也都拿着手机。原来，楼里的老人听说奶奶会用新手机了，都来找她学习。奶奶一边说，一边给他们看。她说得很慢，也很清楚，像一个真的老师。

segs.en: “Grandma,” said Ding Dong, “now you're a teacher too!”
Grandma laughed. “That's right. I have more and more students, and they all learn very quickly.”
Then she looked at Ding Dong and asked, “Why haven't you called your grandma these past two weeks? Have you forgotten how to use a phone?”
Ding Dong laughed so hard he couldn't say a word.

zh: 丁冬说：“奶奶，您现在也是老师了！”奶奶笑着说：“是啊，我的学生越来越多，他们学得都很快。”然后她看着丁冬，问：“你这两个星期怎么不给奶奶打电话？你是不是不会用手机了？”丁冬听了，笑得说不出话来。
